prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Render one landscape high-fidelity UI concept board for ClaudeBar, a native macOS AI-session companion on a notchless external display. Three separated front-facing states across the image: collapsed, selected task, waiting for user. No device frame or browser. Board label "B · Session rail"; state labels "收起", "选中会话", "待确认"; small "示例数据". All interface copy must be crisp and sensibly aligned.
Keep the committed palette: thin silver-white shell, deep indigo content, warm orange only for waiting actions. Subtle optical edges and soft downward shadows. System sans typography; precision, quiet sophistication and bold identifiable proportions, not standard grey app cards.
This alternative is a task rail with a small attached inspector: collapsed view is a wide, shallow horizontal rail with three distinct selectable task slots for Claude, Codex, Cursor and "+7". Slots include marks and tiny meaningful labels; active selection has a recessed indigo segment, waiting has one small orange signal. For expanded state, keep the rail intact and anchor a compact indigo inspector DIRECTLY below the selected middle slot. This spatial origin must be visually obvious, a connected silhouette rather than a detached tooltip with triangle. Inspector shows "ClaudeBar", "Codex · 运行中", "exec · build.sh", and "回到会话 ↗". A narrow silver bottom lip displays "今日 2313.3万 Token" and "$10.54 + ¥3.78". Waiting state opens the inspector from the left task slot with "需要你确认", "Bash · 执行构建命令", orange "去确认 ↗". Keep control positions disciplined. No generic session list, charts, fake progress, rings, continuous shine or photoreal hardware.
note: Visual concept only. Fixture data. Production must preserve native marks and real session capabilities; orange belongs only to waiting actions, not the running button shown in C.
